race.comment: BOTTAS (7) was only beaten a nose at Wagga second up over the mile. He will be fitter again and the efforts over this journey are his best. Will be back in the field early but hard to hold out late. Just wants a firm track to show his best. UNDER THE HAT (13) raced in a weak race but got the job done. That will have given her some added confidence. Many mile runs have been sound. IMPOSING TALLULAH (14) has some recent wins on the board. They were in lesser standard races however the ones in between were more than adequate. SHEANADH (1) came from well back at Echuca. Looks like the mile is what is required. SALINA SPECIAL (15) is usually around the money. His one attempt here was in a similar race when placed.
